Questions about the book list

How many books are on the children's books list?

220 books: 71 children's stories, 65 Christian books, 34 nature and science books, 32 cookbooks, 9 coloring and activity books and 9 books for teens.

Can I search for a book by title?

Yes. Type any word from the title in the search box, such as Noah, bear, moon or lifecycle, and the list narrows as you type. You can also tap a shelf button to show one category.

Where do I buy a book from the list?

Tap Buy on Amazon under any book. The book's Amazon page opens in a new tab, where you can see the formats, price and delivery options.
